events.title: Opportunity implemented: move out cleaning tampa
events.description:
Strengthened internal-link signals for the dedicated Tampa move-out cleaning page by changing prominent homepage and Services page links from the Tampa Bay service-area hub to /move-out-cleaning-tampa/.
GSC showed the query "move out cleaning tampa" distributed across multiple URLs, including the homepage, Tampa transactional page, Wesley Chapel, Brandon, the move-out guide, and Tampa Bay move-out hub. The dedicated /move-out-cleaning-tampa/ page is the intended transactional landing page for Tampa-specific intent, while /move-out-cleaning-tampa-1/ remains the broader Tampa Bay service-area hub. Updated 3 prominent internal links across the homepage and Services page. No canonical, redirect, title, content, schema, or locality-page changes were made. Validation, SEO regression, analytics regression, service-area audit, and production migration gates all passed. Deployed to production 2026-10-06.
